sources.name: Diário do Rio
sources.known_constraint: Public Últimas notícias pagination is advertised by the current frontend and returns 10 dated cards per page; sampled pages 500/625/650 reached June 22/June 3/May 30 on 2026-09-09. A shared resumable scan uses a 1,000-page cap and explicit gaps for unknown dates, chronology, repeated pages or changed markup. Card days guide traversal only; article-page publication dates remain required. Full historical coverage is not yet verified. The supplemental sitemap has 1,000 undated entries covering August 25–September 9 and is deferred for windows up to seven days. Google history remains enabled. The former WordPress API returned HTTP 403 and is not scheduled; lastmod is never publication date. Live 10/09 canary reached page 728 / May 21 for an August 9 window because chronology_gap remained sticky. After ten consecutive ordered pages older than the requested start, stop with an explicit older_page_budget coverage gap; do not report exhaustion. Independent domain/name queries remain enabled.

evidence.basis: Public initial archive exposes data-type=listao, data-sesit=90, data-page=2 on its Mostrar Mais button; primary cards contain visible time datetime day hints.
Advertised public click handler sends GET /index.php with id=/readMore.php, cd_sesit and p, advancing one page after success; only a response equal to the empty PORTAL:FINISH marker hides the button.
existing WordPress collector configuration
Direct public HTTP 200 with an XML urlset, 315,075 bytes; not advertised by robots.txt.
Canary readiness recheck: HTTP 200, 315,061 bytes, 1,000 URL entries with loc/lastmod and zero publication_date fields; captured /tmp/diario-canary-sitemap-live.xml.
